customManagers.description: Dockerfile ARGs annotated with a `# renovate:` comment

packageRules.description: Let new npm/PyPI releases age before proposing them: the image build refuses packages younger than PNPM_CONFIG_MINIMUM_RELEASE_AGE (1 day), and a hijacked release is usually caught within days
Policy and guard changes need a GUARD_VERSION bump; keep them out of automated grouping
